# The generated remote client covers representative list, path, and JSON-body shapes.
env MINA_FX_AUTO_LOAD_ENABLED=false
env MINA_API_KEY=mina_EQO-K-an_paG-dFq7gSKeFafj2rI-41q2FCg2TZVpqO1hHBqwKXI
freeport
exec mina --config-file client-config.toml serve --db $WORK/client-remote.db --yes --host 127.0.0.1 --port $PORT --quiet &server&
httpwait -timeout 10s '"status":"ok"' http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/health

# The remote client is rejected without a key and forwards MINA_API_KEY when present.
env MINA_API_KEY=
! exec mina client --server http://127.0.0.1:$PORT transactions list --limit 1
stderr '"code":"unauthenticated"'
env MINA_API_KEY=mina_EQO-K-an_paG-dFq7gSKeFafj2rI-41q2FCg2TZVpqO1hHBqwKXI

# Demo seeding accepts an exact historical anchor through the generated client.
exec mina client --server http://127.0.0.1:$PORT demo seed --anchor_date 2026-07-15
stdout '"transactions":[1-9][0-9]*'
! stderr .

# Required replacement headers cross the launched CLI boundary into REST.
exec mina client --server http://127.0.0.1:$PORT transactions create --json @replacement.json
stdout '"transaction_id":1061'
! exec mina client --server http://127.0.0.1:$PORT transactions replace 1061 --if-match '"2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"' --json @replacement.json
stderr '"code":"precondition_failed"'

# Query/list output is raw JSON on stdout.
exec mina client --server http://127.0.0.1:$PORT transactions list --limit 5
stdout '"transactions":\['
stdout '"initiated_date":"2026-07-15"'
stdout '"transaction_id":846'
! stderr .

# The generated filter flag preserves DSL quoting, spaces, colons, and glob characters.
exec mina client --server http://127.0.0.1:$PORT transactions list --filter 'category:"Entertainment:*" and not lifecycle:expected' --limit 5
stdout '"transactions":\['
stdout '"total_count":27'
! stderr .

# A path argument selects the transaction observed in the prior list.
exec mina client --server http://127.0.0.1:$PORT transactions get 846
stdout '"transaction_id":846'
stdout '"records":\['
! stderr .

# JSON bodies pass through for successful and failing writes.
exec mina client --server http://127.0.0.1:$PORT tags create --json '{"fqn":"RemoteCLI"}'
stdout '"fqn":"RemoteCLI"'
stdout '"tag_id"'
! stderr .

# One launched-process identity smoke proves the remote CLI's shared request editor.
exec mina client --server http://127.0.0.1:$PORT audit-log list --operation_id createTag --client_surface cli --limit 1
stdout '"client_surface":"cli"'
stdout '"operation_id":"createTag"'
stdout '"total_count":1'
! stderr .

! exec mina client --server http://127.0.0.1:$PORT tags create --json '{}'
! stdout .
stderr '"code":"invalid_request"'
stderr '"message"'

kill -INT server
wait server
